caseName: City of Taunton v. Envtl. Prot. Agency
caseNameFull: CITY OF TAUNTON, MASSACHUSETTS v. ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY.

opinions.text: Motion of City of Dover, New Hampshire for leave to file out of time a brief as amicus curiae denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the First Circuit denied.
